reason: I already reorder my Toplux when it runs out and I don't really need to switch. Also my vitamins sit on the counter and I forget them half the time, so a new box isn't going to fix that.
objection: Individual foil sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I'm already happy with what I reorder.
would_change_my_mind: Recyclable or minimal packaging, plus a clearly lower price than what I pay now for my usual one.
